description: This source file defines a test step bindings class for use with the SpecFlow testing framework in a Selenium-based UI testing project. It provides methods to set up and verify login scenarios for OrangeHRM.

classes.name: LoginSteps
classes.description: A class containing step definitions for login-related scenarios, integrating with SpecFlow for BDD-style tests.

methods.name: GivenOrangeHrmIsAvailableAt
methods.description: Stores the base URL in the scenario context and asserts it's not empty.

methods.name: WhenILoginAsWithPassword
methods.description: Stores username and password in the scenario context and asserts they are not empty.

methods.name: ThenIShouldSeeTheDashboard
methods.description: Checks that previous steps have stored necessary context keys, confirming scenario progression.
